title: VIXEN error-catalog check: a fresh or reconfigured build tree fails until error_catalog_regen has run
body: sn-vixaudit1 try->fail->remedy x2. Action: full WSL Debug build of the merged row. Failure 1: ninja 'codegen/error-catalog/index.json needed by error_catalog_check.stamp missing and no known rule' (vixen_add_codegen_check turns every absolute path argument, including the --out-json/--docs-dir outputs under the build tree, into a DEPENDS). Failure 2 (after regen): the build-tree codegen/error-catalog directory was gone after the next reconfigure and the check failed STALE again. Remedy: run the error_catalog_regen target first, in the same queued payload. Gate: the check must treat build-tree outputs as outputs and produce them itself (extends lane-vixenerrsmoke2's own proposal). Tier reason: one CMake function plus a regen-before-check edge.

title: Concurrent vixen-native.sh bat jobs on one lane race on the native checkout git index.lock
body: sn-vixaudit1: four queued GPU capture jobs for one lane each ran 'vixen-native.sh bat', whose prepare step syncs the same /mnt/c/vixen-native/<lane> checkout; two failed with 'Unable to create .git/index.lock: File exists'. Remedy: rerun the capture without the sync (direct cmd.exe on the already synced checkout). Gate: sync should be a single declared node, or a no-op when the checkout already equals the tip. Extends T-7518. Tier reason: skip the sync when HEAD already equals the tip.

title: Native.NodeWidth and Native.WslRouteLauncher read the live queue reservations (test isolation)
body: sn-vixaudit1: in a full CPU ctest on the laptop-class ws under load both tests failed (NodeWidth: 'this holder's own reservation is skipped: want 0 0 got 5525 0', 'first heavy step sizes to the node: want 18 got 13'; WslRouteLauncher: 'available memory caps the job count: (3000 - 1024 headroom) / 900 = 2'), because nw_other_uncommitted_mb reads the live queue state of other lanes. A rerun shows different numbers (got 1107, 17). Violates the owner test-isolation rule (a test must not depend on live shared state). Tier reason: point the tests at an isolated queue state dir.

title: Core exporting the stbrumme hash include dir breaks the native build: Hash.h resolves to hash.h on Windows
body: sn-vixaudit1 dropped lane-vixin03 from the row: Core links ProjectHash PUBLIC, which exports the stbrumme hash-library include directory; on the case-insensitive Windows tree #include "Hash.h" (ShaderManagement) resolves to stbrumme hash.h (C2039 ComputeSHA256HexFromUint32Vec in ComputePipelineNode.cpp and VulkanGraphApplicationRecipes.cpp). The same change also makes Vixen::Hash::ComputeSHA256Hex real SHA-256 for only the TUs that see HAS_STBRUMME_HASH (ODR hazard) and adds an UNCLASSIFIED mutex to the no-new-mutex ratchet. Needs a hash-provider design, not a merge. Tier reason: cross-TU hash provider design with a Windows witness.

title: Queue: build and capture jobs wait 40-60 minutes behind a stuck GPU benchmark head
body: sn-vixaudit1 on ws 2026-11-11: build jobs (need=4) and plain GPU captures queued 14:42 to 15:09 behind sn-loadscene1 bench jobs (status: stuck-head waits-for=pinned-drain age=1058s), and again 15:55 to 16:30 behind simdrank1:native-bench:build-before-window and the loadscene1 bench window, with 5-9 free tokens and idle CPU. R850.2 under-use: the head holds the box while it waits for a drain. Remedy order R850.1: (a) backfill fitting jobs past a non-running bench head, (b) split bench admission from build admission.
